reviews.title: GOOD FANS AND EXTREME PERFORMANCE
reviews.comment: I bought these to replace the fans that came with my DeepCool LT720 liquid cooler, and I'm really happy with the change. Visually, there's no comparison: these Arctic P12 PRO RGB fans look much nicer, the RGB is more vibrant, and the case looks much better. As for performance, they move a lot of air. I didn't feel any performance loss compared to the original fans of the liquid cooler; on the contrary, the temperatures remained good. Regarding noise, with a well-adjusted speed curve, they don't bother me during normal use. However, when I set them between 70% and 100%, the noise becomes more noticeable and can be a bit annoying, but I think that's normal given the amount of air they move. Overall, I'm happy with the change. If anyone is thinking about replacing their liquid cooler fans with something that offers better aesthetics and good performance, these Arctic fans are a great fit; you just need to configure them properly.
reviews.author: David Sarmiento

reviews.title: Skeptical but happily proved wrong
reviews.comment:
I cannot speak to longevity quite yet. What I can say is that the lofty claims of nearly 7mm H20 static pressure are probably true. Which to be completely honest, I was expecting it to be more marketing fluff then reality. I've been building custom waterloops in PCs for about 20 years. Finding extremely high static pressure fans that aren't poop brown and don't sound like a 747 used to be darn near impossible. This will be my 3rd time purchase Arctic brand fans and my first time with this model. I like their slim 15mm thick fans for builds with very little space to work. Never a single mechanical issue and they've performed exceptionally well for me. So buying this model was an easy decision. Firstly the fans have a really nice weight and feel to them. When you pick them up they do not feel chintzy or low quality. I have two of these going in to a very small Lian Li ITX case so they are my only source of air movement. On top of that, they have to push through a very dense EK radiator. And boy do they! At 100% they are quite audible but not annoyingly so. They push so much air, I don't think you'd ever need 100%. They feel of great quality, they look fantastic if you're in to ARGB and they've very affordable. Compared to top name brands like ASUS, Corsair, Thermaltake, they're like half the cost which is just crazy. I've owned fans from all of those brands and had mechanical issues. Not with Arctic.
Bottom line is they do as advertised and are a reasonable price. I plan to buy extras just incase they discontinue the model.
reviews.author: MB

reviews.title: These fans are perfection, at least for me
reviews.comment:
Big pressure push. Very quiet until they need to be less quiet to provide better airflow. At or near idle, silent.
Excellent value from one of the only companies left that doesn't force you onto their own software just to adjust the fans or use the ARGB. They're all happily controlled by the FanControl app and SignalRGB via an Airgoo ARGB controller. There are no proprietary gymnastics in the wiring whatsoever. Full functionality with whatever you want to use to control them.
They don't have a hint of fragility to them, unlike the Corsair fans I've dealt with recently. Color accuracy seems good, but I only have these and the 140mm version as case fans.
They are exactly what I was looking for in ARGB fans. Big CFM, big pressure, totally open controls.
reviews.author: Ferret

reviews.title: Quality
reviews.comment: Fans are good. RGB are vibrant. Quality LED.  Yes they are loud but very low noise compared to other 3000 rpm fans. And you can adjust fan speed in bios or download a fancurve program to lower speeds a bit for less noise. Only complaint is cables are short and had to buy a extender to work with my rig. Other than that happy with purchase.
reviews.author: Geovanni haro

reviews.title: Great ARGB high performance fans.
reviews.comment: First things first, they are loud IF you have them at full rip. Keep them under 60-70% and I promise they are not loud and they still move plenty of air. These things spin up all the way to 3000rpm which is about 1000rpm more than what most people are used to and they are far quieter at 3000rpm than most other fans that spin up to that speed. They are pretty high quality especially when you take into account their price and they’re far more powerful than the regular P12s that everyone has loved for years. I’d say they’re a wonderful value and you’ll love them as long as you setup your fan curves right. Download Fan Control on your pc to make things way easier on yourself.
